title: phyllanthus graveolens var. tenellus
intro: Phyllanthus graveolens var. tenellus, commonly known as Dwarf Phyllanthus, is a plant species belonging to the family Phyllanthaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Dwarf Phyllanthus include its ability to support liver health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, hepatoprotective, and antioxidant activities.
